weeks.content:
Read a short story and identify verbs and nouns; practice
using plural forms.

Listen to short stories and retell them in your own words;
identify stress in simple words.

Write three sentences using the present continuous tense (I
am reading, I am writing).
Identify main ideas and lessons from simple stories.
Test on reading comprehension and grammar.

Express future actions using "will" and "shall"; e.g., "I will
travel tomorrow."

Use present perfect tense ("I have eaten", "I have gone");
write short sentences using since and for.

Pronounce vowel and diphthong sounds (ow, ou, oi, ea);
aural discrimination exercises.

Write answers to comprehension questions in complete
sentences; practice punctuation.
